items.detail: Not all those who wander are lost. A night sky example is that planets wander, and in fact the very word "planet" comes from "wandering star" in Greek. As planets shift relative to fixed stars, they may appear from our perspective to get closer to other astronomical objects. Such meetings are called conjunctions. They don't happen by chance, but follow the precise laws of celestial mechanics. This peaceful image, captured in Poland, shows the crescent Moon above the Tatra Mountains, and bright Venus close by, a little lower in the horizon. The bright star to the left of Venus is Spica in the constellation of Virgo, the Maiden. Spica is one of the brightest stars in the sky, only about 250 light-years away. It was found in 1890 that Spica is a binary star: two massive blue stars orbiting each other every 4 days. But earlier this year it was reported that Spica, the current companion of…

items.summary: Lev Trockij viene espulso dal Partito Comunista dell'Unione Sovietica, lasciando a Stalin il controllo incontrastato dell'Unione Sovietica.
items.detail:
Lev Trockij viene espulso dal Partito Comunista dell'Unione Sovietica, lasciando a Stalin il controllo incontrastato dell'Unione Sovietica. — Lev Trockij, storicamente italianizzato in Leone Trotskij, nato Lev Davidovič Bronštejn, è stato un politico, rivoluzionario, politologo e militare sovietico proveniente dall'Ucraina; insieme a Lenin fu una delle figure centrali della Rivoluzione d'ottobre e del gruppo dirigente della nascente URSS.
Influente membro del Partito Comunista dell'Unione Sovietica e ideologicamente marxista, i suoi scritti e il suo pensiero ispirarono la scuola ideologica conosciuta come trockismo.

items.title: Earth's fiery birth may have created hundreds of oceans' worth of water
items.summary: Earth's water may have been born in the planet's fiery atmosphere rather than delivered by icy comets or asteroids. Scientists discovered that rocky pebbles reacting with hydrogen under extreme heat…
items.detail: Earth's water may have been born in the planet's fiery atmosphere rather than delivered by icy comets or asteroids. Scientists discovered that rocky pebbles reacting with hydrogen under extreme heat can produce water in minutes, potentially generating hundreds of oceans' worth during Earth's formation. The findings suggest that water may be a natural part of how rocky planets form, rather than something that must arrive from space.

items.title: Scientists discover a common sugar may help cancer cells break free and spread
items.summary: Scientists have uncovered a surprising way that fructose, a sugar commonly found in sweetened foods and drinks, may help aggressive ovarian cancer spread. Researchers discovered that cancer cells…
items.detail: Scientists have uncovered a surprising way that fructose, a sugar commonly found in sweetened foods and drinks, may help aggressive ovarian cancer spread. Researchers discovered that cancer cells surviving chemotherapy release fructose that weakens the bonds holding neighboring tumor cells together, making it easier for cancer to spread. High dietary fructose levels and cholesterol-lowering statins also produced concerning effects in preclinical experiments.
